variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: A strike has collapsed in {colony}. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The colony has seen a strike collapse. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
